tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (11.9:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: color-racing-green-dark
tokens.usage: Darker green for depth and hierarchy.

tokens.name: color-saddle-brown
tokens.usage: Finest English saddles,. Used as text on `.page-subtitle`, `.section-action`, `.card-subtitle`; background on `.section-action:hover`, `.btn-primary`, `.filter-btn:hover, .filter-btn.active`. 6.6:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-cream
tokens.usage: Fine parchment, pristine jodhpurs,. Used as text on `.header`, `.nav-link`, `.stat-value`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-vintage-tan
tokens.usage: Soft warm neutral for subtle backgrounds. Used as background on `tbody tr:hover`.

tokens.name: color-gold
tokens.usage: Racing trophies, brass. Used as background on `.brand-logo`, `.nav-link.active::after`, `.card-badge`; text on `.stat-trend`, `.stat-trend.positive`, `th.sortable::after`. 2.2:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-bronze
tokens.usage: Secondary metallic for competitive rankings. Used as text on `.rank-3`. 2.9:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: Evokes English racing. Used as background on `.header`, `.footer`; text on `.brand-logo`, `.user-avatar`, `.page-title`. 9.0:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-primary-dark
tokens.usage: Darker green for depth and hierarchy. Used as text on `body`, `td`. 11.9:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Racing trophies, brass. Used as background on `.stat-card::before`.

tokens.name: color-background
tokens.usage: Fine parchment, pristine jodhpurs,. Used as background on `body`, `.card-meta`, `.btn-secondary:hover`.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Used as background on `.content-card`, `.table-container`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Soft warm neutral for subtle backgrounds.
